reader_summary.overview: This week, we're counting down the top 5 episodes of 2022. Weighing in at number 3 is Paul Enright - Inside Long Short investing. Paul is a private investor managing his own capital under single-family office, Krainos Capital. Paul opened Krainos after a dozen years at Viking Global Investors.

key_points.text: Paul opened Krainos after a dozen years at Viking Global Investors.
He has a deep understanding of intricacies of long-short equity investing and a knack for explaining it well.
Our conversation covers Paul's career path to Viking, training while there, and advice to early-career investors.
